runbook.title: Studio contacts
runbook.intro: Puddlejump Games: who the studio deals with and the numbers we use.

procedures.title: the build upload notice
procedures.intro: Email the publisher that build {n} is uploaded. Their build-submission address is {value}.
short: Tell {alias} that build {n} is uploaded.
Build {n} is up - let {alias} know please.

procedures.title: the sound-effects request
procedures.intro: Send Fen Audio our request for {n} new sound effects. Their requests address is {value}.
short: Send {alias} our request for {n} new sound effects.
Ask {alias} for {n} new sound effects.

procedures.title: the age-rating update
procedures.intro: Send the ratings board the content update for patch {n}. Their submissions address is {value}.
short: Send {alias} the content update for patch {n}.
Content update for patch {n} to {alias} please.

procedures.title: the build-server credit top-up
procedures.intro: Ask the build-server supplier to top up {n} build hours. We use {name} - orders go to {value}.
short: Top up {n} build hours with the build-server supplier.
We need {n} more build hours - order them please.

procedures.title: the test-device rental
procedures.intro: Rent {n} test phones for next week's playtest. We rent from {name} ({value}).
short: Rent {n} test phones for next week's playtest.
Book {n} test phones for the playtest please.

procedures.title: the translation order
procedures.intro: Send the translators {n} new strings to translate. We use {name} - jobs go to {value}.
short: Send the translators {n} new strings.
{n} new strings for the translators please.

procedures.title: the weekly tools demo
procedures.intro: Put the tools demo on {date} in the studio calendar - it runs {value}.
short: Put the tools demo on {date} in the studio calendar.
Add {date}'s tools demo to the calendar please.

procedures.title: the build freeze window
procedures.intro: Book the build freeze window for {date} in the calendar. The freeze runs {value}.
short: Book the build freeze window for {date} in the calendar.
Build freeze on {date} - put it in the calendar.

procedures.title: a new starter's tools walkthrough
procedures.intro: {who} is starting - add their tools walkthrough on {date} to the calendar. Walkthroughs run {value}.
short: {who} is starting - add their tools walkthrough on {date} to the calendar.
Can you put {who}'s tools walkthrough in the calendar for {date}?

procedures.title: the asset-store budget request
procedures.intro: Email finance ({to}) the asset-store budget request for the week of {date}. The budget is {value}.
short: Send finance the asset-store budget request for the week of {date}.
Can you ask finance for this week's asset budget? Week of {date}.

procedures.title: the playtest snacks request
procedures.intro: Ask the office ({to}) for the playtest snacks allowance for the week of {date} - it's {value}.
short: Ask the office for the playtest snacks allowance for the week of {date}.
Snacks allowance for the playtest please, week of {date}.

procedures.title: the build-health report
procedures.intro: Send the build pipeline owner this week's build-health report: {n} failed builds. That's {name} ({value}).
short: Send the build pipeline owner this week's build-health report: {n} failed builds.
Build-health report to the pipeline owner - {n} failed builds.

procedures.title: the sprint summary
procedures.intro: Send the producer the sprint summary: {n} tickets closed. Our producer is {name} ({value}).
short: Send the producer the sprint summary: {n} tickets closed.
Sprint summary to the producer please - {n} tickets closed.

procedures.title: the code-review reminder
procedures.fact: how many reviewers a merge needs
procedures.intro: Email the team ({to}) this week's code-review reminder: every merge needs {value}.
short: Email the team this week's code-review reminder.
Send the team the review-rule reminder please.

procedures.title: the level-freeze reminder
procedures.fact: how many working days before release the level list freezes
procedures.intro: Email the team ({to}) the release reminder: the level list freezes {value} before release.
short: Email the team the release reminder about the level freeze.
Send the team the level-freeze reminder for this release.
procedures.doc_rule: Freeze the level list {n} working days before release

procedures.title: the playtest reminder
procedures.fact: the minimum playtest length per tester
procedures.intro: Email the testers ({to}) the playtest reminder: each tester plays at least {value}.
short: Email the testers the playtest reminder with the minimum length.
Send the testers the playtest reminder please.

preferences.say_change: Actually, I'd rather have meeting notes as {value} from now on.

preferences.say_first: For the record, my playtest snack is {value}.
preferences.say_change: I've gone off oat bars - it's {value} for me at playtests now.

misstated.fact: the date of the store launch
misstated.fix: Sorry, I misread the email - the launch is {right}, not {wrong}.

misstated.fact: the date of the games expo
misstated.fix: Correction: the expo is on {right}. I had the wrong day.
